notes: Web port and SSL changes no longer depend on PostgreSQL availability
Standard HTTP is port 80 and standard HTTPS is port 443
Computer hostname can be changed from Settings using a rollback-capable root helper
WAN or LAN may be disabled individually; both cannot be disabled together
Dashboard shows only enabled WAN/LAN traffic cards
Operational alerts are consolidated into the notification bell
Samba AD-DC remains non-destructive in 1.0.10; provisioning is intentionally disabled
